 How to setup:
 1. Paste the entirety of this document in the Custom Stylesheet section of your subverse.
 2. Set up the sidebar sections in the following format:

 # [](#h1-red)
 > #[Title of section](#icon-whateverYouWant)
 > Text goes here

 3. The "[](#h1-red)" does not control anything, it's just helpful to remember which color is set there. The color depends on how many #'s there are:
 # = Blue (h1)
 ## = Green (h2)
 ### = Yellow (h3)
 #### = Red (h4)
 ##### = Purple (h5)
 ###### = White (h6)
 4. You must put everything in that section into the same block quote. 
 5. Use the Icon section below to choose which icon you want. 
 5a. Note that you can easily create new icons or replace old ones. Whatever can be expressed in text can be made into an icon.
